title: Broader peer evidence: operation-specific DXF preservation and writer acceptance
mode: Primary-source documentation and source review plus local plan reconciliation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Compare current open-source DXF/DWG peer disclosures across direct codecs, conversion tools, and a downstream CAD consumer.
Separate unknown-record retention, object import/copy, writer output, independent reopen, and native CAD acceptance.
Refine the existing PAR-07/S8 composed evidence checkpoint and PAR-138 DXF serializer controls without adding new findings or routine test work.

sources.name: GNU LibreDWG documentation and test tooling
sources.observed: The versioned 0.13.4 manual describes broad ASCII DXF writing, reports that AutoCAD fails to import some generated files (approximately 10% in that project statement), says DXF reading works for most objects, describes Binary DXF reading as complete but untested, and Binary DXF output as under construction. The manual/repository also provide fuzzing and conversion/round-trip tooling for DWG, DXF, and DXFB. These are project disclosures and methods, not an executed current binary result.

sources.name: ezdxf entity serialization, XREF/import, and resource mapping
sources.observed: The source exposes raw tag storage and structured entity export. The XREF/import documentation states that unsupported and unknown/proxy entities and some document features are not transferred by that operation; known resource handles are mapped by copy/resource workflows. Unknown-tag retention in a supported document read/write path therefore cannot be generalized to semantic copy, import, transform, or reference-closed graph preservation.

sources.name: IxMilia.Dxf compatibility cautions and changelog
sources.observed: The project warns that some entity writer outputs may not open in AutoCAD or need additional required information. Its changelog records discrete fixes for block-contained handle resolution, valid handle assignment, XDATA placement, and version/encoding-sensitive output. This supports test-shape selection only; it is not proof of a libdxfrw defect or peer-wide acceptance.

sources.name: FreeCAD DXF and DWG consumer route documentation
sources.observed: FreeCAD documents DWG import as external DWG-to-DXF conversion followed by a selected DXF importer, and says its stock importer cannot read embedded ACIS/SAT solids. A FreeCAD result measures a converter-plus-importer consumer path and is not, by itself, a DWG-reader or ACIS/AcDs semantic result.

assessment.planImpact: Clarifies that direct strict read, same-document rewrite, raw unknown retention, XREF/import/copy, transform, cross-version conversion, independent reopen, and native acceptance are distinct evidence operations. PAR-138 remains on its existing bounded typed-over-raw implementation path; repeated ambiguous fields and unremappable references stay fail-closed. Peer comparisons and fuzzing remain at scheduled composed/hardening checkpoints, not per implementation slice.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source documentation/source review and local plan reconciliation
method.limitations: The LibreDWG failure percentage is a versioned project self-report, not a current independent measurement and not evidence about libdxfrw. GitHub master source/docs are mutable. Peer documentation is not an execution. No local serializer test was run in this research-only update; no support capability, peer interoperability, or native CAD result is promoted.
